infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Loadsy uses your location only to fill in your ZIP code, so it can look up truck rental rates near you. Your location is never stored or sent anywhere — you can always type the ZIP in instead.

plugins.photosPermission: Loadsy reads the photos you select to identify furniture and estimate your moving volume. It never uploads photos you haven't selected.
plugins.cameraPermission: Loadsy uses your camera to photograph rooms so it can identify your furniture and estimate how much truck space your move needs. Photos are used only to build your inventory.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Loadsy uses your location only to fill in your ZIP code, so it can look up truck rental rates near you. Your location is never stored or sent anywhere — you can always type the ZIP in instead.
